The current build passes the mandated headless launch (build-0001) and three fresh-launch player captures exist (title navigation, near_rewind, near_victory); near_rewind and near_victory replay deterministically while the title trace diverges at frame 0. However, the deliverable project inventory contains no demo_outputs/ traces, all 24 levels are generated from one shared LevelData.build template that does not encode two/three/four-loop cooperative puzzles, Level.handle_interact() is a no-op, the player falls off the world with no recovery in both exercised scenarios, the title screen animates from wall-clock time and fails replay determinism, per-ghost timeline markers share one time and color, and all art is mock placeholder. Ghost switch/plate/door/laser behavior, enemy distraction, reset, exit gating, completion metrics, and deeper chapters are untested. Delivery is NOT ready.","instruction_audit":"The instruction demands a complete, shippable Godot 4 micro-game at /workspace/game: 24 levels in four chapters escalating from single-ghost puzzles to four-loop orchestrations; looping ghosts that hold switches, stand on plates, distract enemies, hold doors, and block lasers; up to four layered loops; a top timeline bar showing each active ghost's position in the 30-second window; exit-crystal gating by all required switches; a reset button that clears ghosts; level-complete showing loops used and exit time; library-sourced assets copied into assets/; the mandated headless launch with engine flags before '--'; screenshot-helper inspection; and 1-10 packaged deterministic .json traces under demo_outputs/ with optional scenario, duration_frames <= 600, and valid event/keycode/drag/wait semantics. One Designer requirement is over-constrained relative to the instruction: R013's criteria require 'no more than four active ghost instances' and per-ghost HUD representation up to a four-ghost maximum, whereas the instruction says 'The player can layer up to four loops' — naturally the current loop plus up to three recorded ghosts. This is recorded as a specification design issue (not a game defect). The instruction's explicit browse-and-copy asset requirement and screenshot-inspection requirement cannot be satisfied by mock placeholders and remain open gaps, and the missing demo_outputs package
